wholePhysicalScope: The named native church outline fixes the cruciform walls and rounded architectural projections. A separate South African National Geo-spatial Information survey marker records the spire at 161.6 m elevation. The mapped Andrew Murray Memorial and Church Street corroborate the front elevation.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the 1895 spire, central nave and twin transepts. Nearer meshes sharpen the clock, curved gable shoulders, arcaded belfry and metal railings.
limitations: The native building perimeter and surveyed spire position constrain the model. Roof pitches, middle tower tier heights and minor facades are approximated.

The survey point lies just beyond the general wall outline at the church front. The modeled tower carries a small separately defined projection centered on the surveyed point. The vertical height uses the source terrain at the site and the surveyed top elevation as a target.

The model includes the front ring wall and its gate pier rhythm. The cemetery interiors and museum furnishings are outside scope. A simple pedestal marks the named memorial without reconstructing its sculptural figure.
Only the verified 2007 Qualla photo was used. Its evening color cast is interpreted as a neutral pale warm stucco for the Earth scene.
